types.means: 66 of 144 heads cleared all three gates — 3.0σ above their own null, more attention on the offset than chance under the causal mask would give it, AND that offset being the single target the head attends to most — and are labelled (13 induction, 15 previous-token, 2 duplicate-token, 36 sink); the rest read 'no type detected', which is a result rather than a gap. Measured on 6 random token sequences of length 24, repeated once — this is BEHAVIOUR ON REPEATED RANDOM TOKENS, not a claim about real text, and it must not be read as explaining the ablation ranking: a head can be labelled and irrelevant, or unlabelled and load-bearing.

direct.means: 40 of 157 components are listed, the strongest by magnitude; the other 117 were decomposed and are not shown. Direct contribution to the logit for ' Paris', in logits, each shift-corrected against its own vocabulary mean. They sum to 14.9973 against the model's real 14.7933 — a reconstruction residual of -0.2039 (1.38%), which is what freezing the LayerNorm scale cost on this run. 141 of 157 components fall below that residual: their direct effect cannot be told from the approximation's own error, which is not the same as their being unimportant. DIRECT-PATH ONLY — a head that feeds a later head shows near zero here and can still decide the answer.
